paper.title: Manifold-constrained plasticity enables stable learning in recurrent neural circuits

official_code_artifact.status: exact Figshare record and download file id recovered; ZIP bytes still blocked by redirect transport

source_equations_checked: Eq.1 uses elementwise tanh in tau*r_dot = -r + tanh(Wr + I + I_fb + noise).
Q is N x k with orthonormal columns; the paper defines the structural manifold M = span(Q).
Eq.4 uses W = Q W_k Q^T and states that rank-k W makes all outside-manifold components decay exponentially.
Eq.34 defines rotational drift as Q(t+dt) = Q(t) R(dtheta), with R explicitly k x k and a rotation matrix.
Methods Eqs.35-37 measure empirical subspace drift by principal angles from singular values of U0^T Ut.

bounded_source_consistency_audit.status: mathematical/source-level audit; not an empirical reproduction

rotation_invariance.proof: For orthonormal Q in R^{N x k} and orthogonal R in R^{k x k}, span(QR)=span(Q) and (QR)(QR)^T = QQ^T. Therefore Eq.34 as printed rotates coordinates/basis inside the same ambient k-dimensional structural subspace; it does not rotate that structural subspace in R^N.
rotation_invariance.source_tension: The paper describes Eq.34 as an evolving manifold basis and later says frozen U becomes poorly aligned with an evolving population subspace. That can still occur if the empirical activity covariance changes inside/leaks outside the structural span, or if code implements a different rotation; however Eq.34 alone does not move span(Q). Official code is required before interpreting S8/S11/S12 as ambient subspace rotation.

nonlinear_confinement_guard.derivation: Low-rank W alone does not mathematically guarantee exact confinement for Eq.1 as printed. Even if Wr+I+I_fb lies in span(Q), elementwise tanh(Qa) is generically not in span(Q), so P_perp*tanh(Qa) can drive outside-manifold activity. Full-dimensional iid noise is an additional potential leakage source unless projected in code.
nonlinear_confinement_guard.scope: This does not show that the published constrained runs materially leave the manifold. At small activation amplitudes leakage is tiny, and the implementation may explicitly project states/inputs/noise even though that projection is not shown in Eq.1. It does show that the printed rank-k argument is not sufficient by itself for exact confinement.

bounded_source_consistency_audit.interpretation: The highest-value unresolved issue is now source-versus-code semantics for constrained and rotational-drift dynamics, ahead of further effect-size comparisons. The right-multiplication rotation is structurally span-invariant, while the printed nonlinear state equation can introduce empirical leakage. S11 can therefore only be interpreted cleanly after inspecting how the official code updates Q/W/r, projects noise/input, and computes principal angles.

candidate_update.new_interpretation: Adaptive empirical-subspace tracking remains plausible and prior reduced controls support the value of tracking drifting representations. However the paper's rotational-drift experiment is more implementation-dependent than its prose suggests: Eq.34 is a within-span basis rotation, while exact confinement is not guaranteed by Eq.1+rank-k W alone. Do not treat S8/S11/S12 as clean evidence for ambient structural-manifold rotation until the official code resolves these semantics.
